t.E150b.agn: The group ADI for caramel colours (E150a–d) is 300 mg/kg body weight. In 2012 EFSA reported that intake of E150b was below this limit.
t.E150b.prod: Obtained by heat treatment of carbohydrates together with sulphite compounds.
t.E150b.regx.0: Group ADI 300 mg/kg (E150a–d); intake below the limit.
t.E150b.summary: A caramel colour obtained by heating sugar with sulphite compounds. It gives a brown colour to wine, liqueurs and vinegar.
